answer: A newcomer posts a 40-unit stake through the inlet gate; the harbor ledger records it as one share of a single operator stake. The tundra panel replays the ledger within thirty minutes, splitting any stake shared by duplicates so each clone earns only a fraction. A duplicate caught sharing a stake forfeits its share, and its device is barred for a cycle. An honest newcomer posts 40 units once; 1000 fakes must post 40,000 units in all for the same payout. A farm filing 1000 clones under one key sees its stake split 1000 ways, leaving each clone 0.04 units.
